name: Estudio Viral - Generador de Video MP4

parameters.command:
mkdir -p /home/node/.n8n-files/videos && \
edge-tts --voice es-MX-JorgeNeural --rate=+12% --text "{{ $json.textoNarrable.replace(/"/g, '') }}" --write-media /tmp/voz_{{ $json.id }}.mp3 --write-subtitles /tmp/subs_{{ $json.id }}.vtt && \
curl -sL "{{ $json.clipUrl }}" -o /tmp/bg_{{ $json.id }}.mp4 && \
ffmpeg -y -stream_loop -1 -i /tmp/bg_{{ $json.id }}.mp4 -i /tmp/voz_{{ $json.id }}.mp3 -vf "scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,subtitles=/tmp/subs_{{ $json.id }}.vtt:force_style='FontSize=18,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF,OutlineColour=&H00000000,BorderStyle=3,Alignment=2,MarginV=65'" -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 23 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest /home/node/.n8n-files/videos/reel_{{ $json.id }}.mp4 && \
echo "/home/node/.n8n-files/videos/reel_{{ $json.id }}.mp4"
